333-5147-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-5147-8207.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

245-2034-7824.description:
Activate Marneus by paying {6}, creating four creature tokens due to Bard.
When the tokens enter, Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three creature tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3678-8102.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-3678-8102.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Retreat to Emeria and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

522-5231--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Repeat.

222-527-3899-5223.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3899-5223.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1981-2034-2415-6719.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2034-2415-6719.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

5078-7693-7902.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
5078-7693-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Armor Wars.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library
Repeat

969-3259-5982.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-5982.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Ancient Gold Dragon, triggering Breath of Fury and Ancient Gold Dragon.
Resolve the Ancient Gold Dragon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more oil counters on it

1987-3120-5913.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-3120-5913.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Pinnacle Monk
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3120-5913.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

3771-4217-7101.description:
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Animar.
Repeat from step 3.
3771-4217-7101.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {2} if Animar starts with +1/+1 counters.

222-527-2292-4460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2292-4460.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1434-2506-6441-7150.description:
Cast Kirol either from your hand or the command zone by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3534-5256-7084.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You control another nonland creature.
You control another nonland creature.
You control seven or more lands that have different names.
3534-5256-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 black Zombie creature token
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
3534-5256-7084.notes: The land you earthbend can be Field of the Dead.

2558-4659-7082.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sokka and Suki trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Ally.
Repeat from step 2.

57-2751-4846-4885.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-2751-4846-4885.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

5900-6913-7009.description:
Activate Chameleon using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Chameleon. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

4050-4853-4888.description:
Activate Puppet's Conjurer by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a 0/1 Homunculus artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Homunculus, adding {U}.
When the Homunculus dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Puppet's Conjurer.
Repeat.

3088-4131-4893.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith and Xenic Poltergiest do not have summoning sickness.
3088-4131-4893.description:
Activate Xenic Poltergeist by tapping it, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

509-1267-2392-5547.easyPrerequisites: Silverskin Armor attached to Medomai the Ageless.
509-1267-2392-5547.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-2392-5547.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris and Thrummingbird.
Idris and Thrummingbird trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Thrummingbird trigger, putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 5.

1021-2034-2345-2653.description:
Play Drownyard Temple triggering landfall.
Use Nissa to gain {G} and Embodiment of Insight to make Drownyard Temple a creature.
Sacrifice Drownyard Temple to Ashnod's Altar.
Repeat.

1680-3665-4508.notablePrerequisites:
Runed Stalactite attached to Penregon Strongbull.
You control at least one additional artifact.
You have at least three opponents.
1680-3665-4508.description:
Activate Penregon Strongbull by paying {1} and sacrificing an artifact, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Malcolm triggers for each opponent dealt damage this way, creating that many Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

453-2601-2743.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four other creatures.
Your life total is at least three.
453-2601-2743.description:
Cast Imperial Seal by paying {B}, causing you to search your library for Biovisionary, then shuffle your library, put Biovisionary on top of it, and lose 2 life.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Deceiver of Form triggers, revealing Biovisionary from the top of your library and causing all other creatures you control to become copies of Biovisionary until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Deceiver of Form and each Biovisionary trigger.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

914-2034-2815-5220.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Treasure.
Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2034-2815-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.
Dockside Extortionist dies, triggering Mortuary, causing you to put Dockside Extortionist on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Professional Face-Breaker by sacrificing a Treasure, exiling Dockside Extortionist from the top of your library and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Cast Dockside Extortionist from exile by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1232-2713-4289-5153.notablePrerequisites: Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
1232-2713-4289-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {G}.
Pay {G} to create a 1/1 Saproling token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

2290-2919.easyPrerequisites: Spike Feeder has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2290-2919.description:
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Spike Feeder to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, including Spike Feeder.
Repeat for infinite life and infinite +1/+1 counters on all creatures you control, other than Spike Feeder.
